# Polaris AI

> Polaris is a free Chrome extension that detects headings in AI chat answers and lets you jump to each section with edge markers, a Table of Contents and an Outline.

Polaris AI (store name "Polaris: AI Chat Navigator") works on ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Doubao, Kimi, Qwen, Yuanbao, Diandian AI, Manus, and DeepSeek. It processes conversations locally in the browser and never uploads chat content. The website is published at https://polaris-ai.work/.

## Install

- [Homepage](https://polaris-ai.work/): Product overview, how it works, features, pricing and installation.
- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/polaris-ai-chat-navigator/lkdbbnpcfkjdfnopecpbdaeegncdmajb): Official Chrome listing.
- [GitHub releases](https://github.com/Jeffery-Ho/Polaris-AI-Chat-Navigator/releases/latest): Offline ZIP for manual installation.

## Pricing

- Free: two supported platforms at a time, no payment details needed.
- Pro: all supported platforms and Long conversation mode, which keeps more earlier messages in the Table of Contents. One-time purchase, no subscription. $12.90 during the first 7 days of the free trial, then $19.99.

## Long conversation mode and privacy

Long conversation mode keeps more earlier messages available for navigation; it does not guarantee every message is available. Retained messages live only in the current page’s memory, are cleared on refresh or when switching chats, and are not written to disk, synced or uploaded. Copy or export available content as Markdown or HTML to pass context to another AI assistant.

The extension supports Chrome, Microsoft Edge and Firefox.
